Line.DefaultText: You've heard, then, the Apothecary's Cabin stands finished. I taught that woman her Herbalism same as I'm teaching you, and now she's the one mixing draughts instead of me lecturing about them. There's a particular satisfaction in watching a student outgrow the lectern entirely. Do visit her stall if you haven't; between the two of us this village is dangerously well medicated.
